page_title: GEN 1-1 INT | Genoa v Inter 29/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Daniele Doveri has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Josep Martinez (Genoa) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
90+5' Josep Martinez (Genoa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+5' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes a direct free kick.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Total attempts – 13:15.
90' Simone Inzaghi prepares a substitution. Yann Bisseck is replaced by Benjamin Pavard (Inter).
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Henrikh Mkhitaryan leaves the pitch and Davy Klaassen (Inter) comes on.
89' Davide Frattesi (Inter) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
86' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
85' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
83' Genoa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
81' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
81' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) takes the resulting corner which is well defended. The referee signals a corner kick to Inter.
79' It will be a substitution. Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is ready to enter the pitch as Matteo Darmian walks off.
78' Substitution. Nicolo Barella leaves the pitch and is replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
78' Here is a change. Aaron Martin is going off and Alberto Gilardino gives the last tactical orders to Junior Messias (Genoa).
77' Nicolo Barella (Inter) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
74' The current number of shots on goal is 4:6.
71' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alexis Sanchez (Inter) replacing Marko Arnautovic.
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Radu Dragusin (Genoa) was quite harsh and Daniele Doveri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
69' Genoa win a corner.

68' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) creates himself some space inside the goalmouth and connects with the resulting free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the bottom right corner, but Josep Martinez pulls off a superb reflex save to thwart him.
67' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) will take the free kick.
67' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
65' A player from Genoa takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
61' Alberto Gilardino decides to make a substitution. Kevin Strootman will be replaced by Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa).
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mateo Retegui (Genoa) is coming onto the pitch as Caleb Ekuban cannot continue after picking up an injury.
58' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
56' Alberto Gilardino isn't happy on the touchline after referee Daniele Doveri shows him a yellow card.
56' Nicolo Barella (Inter) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
54' There's an opportunity for Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
51' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
51' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) smashes the ball upfield and Nicolo Barella controls it with a great first touch.
51' One of the Genoa players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle.
48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.
46' Half-time substitution. Alberto Gilardino decided to make a change. Koni De Winter (Genoa) is replaced by Johan Vasquez.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+11' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+10' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
45+10' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
45+9' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle after Matteo Darmian (Inter) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
45+7' 1 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Radu Dragusin (Genoa) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
45+7' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) will take the corner.
45+7' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play and Genoa manage to earn a corner.
45+6' Carlos Augusto (Inter) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Josep Martinez is alert and denies him.
45+3' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.

45+2' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Yann Sommer shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
45' 9 additional min. will be played.
43' 0 - 1 Goal! Marko Arnautovic (Inter) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 0:1.
42' Nicolo Barella (Inter) picked up a rebound and unleashed a fine effort which crashed against the left post.
42' Matteo Darmian (Inter) takes a quick throw-in so that his teammates can outnumber the defenders in the penalty box.
41' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
40' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is penalised for holding. Daniele Doveri signals a set piece.
38' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
36' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful low volley was directed towards the middle of the net, but Josep Martinez was alert and made an astonishing save!
35' Yann Bisseck (Inter) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
35' Marcus Thuram is able to continue with the attacking effort as he latches on to a beautiful defence-splitting lofted pass, which was supplied by Yann Bisseck (Inter).
34' Daniele Doveri blows for a foul after Radu Dragusin (Genoa) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
34' Aaron Martin (Genoa) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
32' The free kick is taken by Aaron Martin (Genoa), but ball is cleared.
31' Aaron Martin (Genoa) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
30' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
30' Radu Dragusin (Genoa) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Genoa have been awarded a corner kick.
29' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
27' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
24' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Josep Martinez.
24' A player from Genoa pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Free kick. Inter will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
23' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
16' The game is interrupted.
15' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
13' Genoa are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
13' Daniele Doveri interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter).
9' Marcus Thuram (Inter) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the top left corner. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Josep Martinez makes a comfortable save.
7' The referee blows his whistle as Kevin Strootman (Genoa) was too aggressive in his challenge.
7' Koni De Winter (Genoa) sends an accurate short pass. Aaron Martin controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
5' Daniele Doveri blows his whistle as Marko Arnautovic (Inter) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
4' The ball is cleared after Yann Bisseck (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
3' Neat passing move from Inter in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' A precise short pass from Marko Arnautovic releases Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) in space inside the box, but he smashes a wild shot well past the left post.
1' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
